definitions.gloss: drafting; drawing up; preparing a proposal or plan
definitions.explanation: The act of creating a draft of a plan, proposal, bill, or official document. Commonly used in business and government contexts.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{企画|きかく}を{起案|きあん}する。
examples.english: To draft a new project proposal.

examples.japanese: {部長|ぶちょう}が{起案|きあん}した{計画|けいかく}が{承認|しょうにん}された。
examples.english: The plan drafted by the department head was approved.

examples.japanese: {法案|ほうあん}の{起案|きあん}にあたっては、{関係|かんけい}{省庁|しょうちょう}との{調整|ちょうせい}が{不可欠|ふかけつ}だ。
examples.english: When drafting a bill, coordination with the relevant ministries is essential.

notes:
Composed of {起|き} (to start, to originate) and {案|あん} (plan, proposal). The word emphasizes the initial creation of a plan or document, before it is reviewed or approved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {企画|きかく}を{起案|きあん}する (to draft a project proposal)
- {法案|ほうあん}を{起案|きあん}する (to draft a bill)
- {起案|きあん}{者|しゃ} (drafter, originator)
- {起案|きあん}{書|しょ} (draft proposal document)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {起案|きあん}: to draft, to draw up (formal, initial creation of a plan)
- {立案|りつあん}: to formulate a plan (broader, emphasizes planning process)
- {草案|そうあん}: draft, preliminary version (the document itself, not the act)
